arguments.summary: The job_runner service is currently degraded with 100 workers in use and no throughput. The failed_jobs table export using pg_dump is ongoing and should complete in about 20 minutes. The backlog in the jobs database is growing due to the degraded service.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Restart the job_runner service to bring it out of degraded state and improve worker throughput. Once the service is back to normal, review and address the root cause of the degradation.
